lessons_learned: AGENTS.md references port 3000 but actual backend port is 3001 — environment docs need a sweep
Flutter Web build output (src/frontend/build/, 2.3GB) persists on disk despite being gitignored — should be cleaned up or integrated into a build script
Local repo is 11 commits behind origin/main — stale for 8 days since May 17. Need automated pull or CI sync.
Full test suite (>120s timeout) may need parallelization or selective test running for CI viability
Flutter SDK not available in CI/cron environment — Flutter Web deploy must be done manually or on a Flutter-equipped runner
ESLint autofix produces mixed formatting choices (imports expanded, function signatures compacted) — RESOLVED with unified .prettierrc (2026-05-27)
Cron environment cannot reach external HTTPS (curl to lingxi.chataifree.eu.org times out) — health check must use localhost ports (18789/3001) in cron context
QuickVideoGenerateDto renderEngine field typed as 'string' causes TS2322 when passed to service expecting VideoRenderEngine union — use 'as VideoRenderEngine' cast or @IsIn() validator
Frontend-web integration follows a clean pattern: types → API service → component → dashboard. QuickVideoGenerator reuses existing polling infrastructure from LessonGenerator.
Cron auto-push is critical — 7 commits accumulated locally on 2026-05-30 without reaching remote. Evolution analysis #8 committed but didn't push. Now resolved.
Android INTERNET permission was missing from release AndroidManifest.xml — only RECORD_AUDIO was declared. This would cause release APK network failures. Fixed + documented in apk-build-report.md.
ESLint formatting issues accumulate gradually — each analysis should run eslint --fix to catch pre-existing drift before it becomes a large diff.
Pre-commit hook (.githooks/pre-commit) catches ESLint issues at commit time — runs --fix + --cache for fast incremental checks. Requires git config core.hooksPath .githooks.
AGENTS.md infrastructure description incorrectly listed OpenClaw Gateway (port 18789) in API path — actually only used for bot channels, not backend routing
Frontend-web lacks ESLint config (no eslint.config.js) — prettier is configured but ESLint 9+ requires flat config. Low priority since npm run lint works via package.json scripts.
Flutter logout navigation unreliable on Flutter Web — use async/await + addPostFrameCallback to ensure reliable navigation back to login screen after logout
Flutter Web build service worker version regenerates on each build — minor diffs in public/ are normal and don't require commit unless code actually changed
LlmClientService.chatCompletion() returns LlmResponse with direct .content field, NOT .choices[].message.content — the older OpenAI SDK format was different
Use rsync --delete instead of cp -r when deploying Flutter Web builds — cp leaves orphaned files (old service workers, unused assets) that cause 404s and cache issues
better-sqlite3 native bindings can fail on Node.js version mismatch or CI environments — app.module.ts now probes at startup and falls back to sql.js (pure JS) transparently (symphony/fix-19)
remotion-render.service.spec.ts zero-byte buffer test can timeout at 20s — mock the remotion-ts-validator module to prevent real filesystem operations (fix/issue-23)

Full unit test suite (npx jest --testPathPattern='unit/') can hang beyond 300s — likely caused by remotion-render or orchestrator tests with lingering handles. Run individual test files for reliability.

Controller tests follow a simple pattern: mock the service, instantiate the controller directly, verify delegation and argument conversion (string→number). No NestJS testing module needed for pure unit tests.

ai.controller.generateCoursePack() was missing 'await' before this.aiService.generateCoursePack() — the try/catch block was dead code because the returned promise rejection was not caught. Fixed by adding 'await'. Always check that async service calls inside try/catch blocks are properly awaited.

Flutter 'BuildContext used across async gap' warnings are fixed by adding 'if (!mounted) return;' (or 'if (!context.mounted) return;' in newer Flutter) after every await before using context. fix/issue-31 applied this to 6 files.

Contents controller auth guard was at class level (all endpoints required JWT). fix/issue-34 moved it to method level — GET endpoints (findAll, findById) are now public, POST (create) still requires auth. This is correct for an education app where content browsing should be open.
Voice TTS endpoint was behind JWT guard — fix/issue-34 removed it, making /voice/tts public. This is reasonable since TTS is used by unauthenticated contexts (e.g., preview audio before login).
